A newly created **Fighter** starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23 — note ID 23 is actually "Torches" despite code comments calling it Rations, per bug B-09).

**Defined in:** `worker/src/services/character.ts` — `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` constant (line 65), used by `createCharacter` (line 14, gear assigned at lines 59/65). Item names/IDs come from `items` rows in `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (insert order determines ID).
